snippet.title: Lost Vulcan | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Lost Vulcan is a platform game that combines the adrenaline of roguelites with the spirit of classic arcade titles. Play as a brave treasure hunter and enter 'Vulcan', an abandoned interstellar ship said to be filled with legendary riches... and mortal dangers.
